macros.name: answernumberfont
macros.doc: The \answernumberfont macro takes one mandatory argument which redefines the font to use for displaying the answer number.

macros.name: answerstitlefont
macros.doc: The \answerstitlefont macro takes one mandatory argument which redefines the font to use for the answers title.

macros.name: correctionstyle
macros.doc: The appearance of the contents of the correction environment can be adjusted by using the \correctionstyle macro.

macros.name: headerfont
macros.doc: The \headerfont macro takes one mandatory argument which redefines the font to use for the headers (first line and first column) of the form and mask arrays.

macros.name: makemask
macros.doc: Based on the questions appearing in your document, QCM has the ability to generate a “form” (a grid that your students will have to fill in), and a “mask” (the same grid, only with correct answers properly checked in).

macros.name: questionspace
macros.doc: \questionspace is the amount of extra vertical space to put under the question, before the list of proposed answers.

envs.name: correction
envs.doc: To typeset explanations below the questions, use the correction environment (no argument).

envs.name: question
envs.doc: The proposed answers are displayed below the question in a list fashion (the question environment is a list-based one).
